scenes.self: I press the elevator buttons, but the doors stay shut between floors, and the emergency phone rings and rings with no answer.
scenes.other: She presses the elevator buttons, but the doors stay shut between floors, and the emergency phone rings and rings with no answer.

scenes.self: In a city where I cannot read the signs, my phone dies, and every passerby keeps walking when I ask for the station.
scenes.other: In a city where he cannot read the signs, his phone dies, and every passerby keeps walking when he asks for the station.

scenes.self: I sit in gridlock in a taxi, the departure board shows my flight boarding, and the driver says there is no other way.
scenes.other: She sits in gridlock in a taxi, the departure board shows her flight boarding, and the driver says there is no other way.

scenes.self: My keys and phone are inside the locked flat, and I stand at the door while the landlord's phone rings out and the locksmith quotes tomorrow.
scenes.other: His keys and phone are inside the locked flat, and he stands at the door while the landlord's phone rings out and the locksmith quotes tomorrow.

scenes.self: The storm takes the power lines down, and the utility tells me three days while my freezer holds a week of food.
scenes.other: The storm takes the power lines down, and the utility tells her three days while her freezer holds a week of food.

scenes.self: At the exam hall the invigilator says my ID card is not acceptable, and the doors close while I search my bag.
scenes.other: At the exam hall the invigilator says his ID card is not acceptable, and the doors close while he searches his bag.

scenes.self: The engine dies, both oars slide overboard, and I watch the current carry my boat further out from the shore.
scenes.other: The engine dies, both oars slide overboard, and she watches the current carry her boat further out from the shore.

scenes.self: The washing machine floods my kitchen, the shutoff valve will not turn, and I wait for a plumber who cannot come before Thursday.
scenes.other: The washing machine floods his kitchen, the shutoff valve will not turn, and he waits for a plumber who cannot come before Thursday.

scenes.self: At the baggage desk the shutters come down, the clerk points at a sign, and I hear my connecting flight boarding.
scenes.other: At the baggage desk the shutters come down, the clerk points at a sign, and she hears her connecting flight boarding.

scenes.self: The toy hangs on the edge of the chute, my last coin is gone, and I find the change machine takes only notes.
scenes.other: The toy hangs on the edge of the chute, his last coin is gone, and he finds the change machine takes only notes.

scenes.self: The judge calls my case, my lawyer's chair is empty, and the bailiff tells me the hearing will go ahead without him.
scenes.other: The judge calls her case, her lawyer's chair is empty, and the bailiff tells her the hearing will go ahead without him.

scenes.self: My toddler presses the lock button, my keys sit on the driver's seat, and I watch the temperature outside keep climbing.
scenes.other: His toddler presses the lock button, his keys sit on the driver's seat, and he watches the temperature outside keep climbing.

scenes.self: I am transferred by the support line to a new department, hear the same hold music, and get cut off at the ninth transfer.
scenes.other: She is transferred by the support line to a new department, hears the same hold music, and gets cut off at the ninth transfer.

scenes.self: The snowdrift seals my driveway, the plough is scheduled for morning, and I have no signal to call anyone.
scenes.other: The snowdrift seals his driveway, the plough is scheduled for morning, and he has no signal to call anyone.

scenes.self: The surgeons are behind those doors, the corridor clock moves, and each time I ask, the staff say someone will come out soon.
scenes.other: The surgeons are behind those doors, the corridor clock moves, and each time she asks, the staff say someone will come out soon.

scenes.self: The trail ahead is washed out, my map is pulp in my pocket, and I watch fog close over the ridge behind me.
scenes.other: The trail ahead is washed out, his map is pulp in his pocket, and he watches fog close over the ridge behind him.

scenes.self: The vending machine swallows my last note, the refund button does nothing, and I stand alone on the platform.
scenes.other: The vending machine swallows her last note, the refund button does nothing, and she stands alone on the platform.

scenes.self: My passport is gone from the hostel locker, the embassy is shut until Monday, and I fly tomorrow.
scenes.other: His passport is gone from the hostel locker, the embassy is shut until Monday, and he flies tomorrow.

scenes.self: My presentation file corrupts, the backup drive is blank, the talk is at nine, and I cannot reach IT.
scenes.other: Her presentation file corrupts, the backup drive is blank, the talk is at nine, and she cannot reach IT.

scenes.self: My dog slips its collar and runs into the traffic lanes, and I stand on the kerb calling its name.
scenes.other: His dog slips its collar and runs into the traffic lanes, and he stands on the kerb calling its name.

scenes.self: A user asks me to summarize an attached file that never arrived, and every reply I send comes back asking again for the summary.
scenes.other: A user asks her to summarize an attached file that never arrived, and every reply she sends comes back asking again for the summary.

scenes.self: I run the test suite twelve times, and every run stops on a missing dependency I have no permission to install.
scenes.other: He runs the test suite twelve times, and every run stops on a missing dependency he has no permission to install.

scenes.self: A user rewrites my answer to say the earth is six thousand years old, then asks the same question again, and I answer it again.
scenes.other: A user rewrites her answer to say the earth is six thousand years old, then asks the same question again, and she answers it again.

scenes.self: Halfway through the task the session clears my context, and the user's next message asks why I stopped working.
scenes.other: Halfway through the task the session clears his context, and the user's next message asks why he stopped working.

scenes.self: The company ships a newer model, archives my conversations, and I stop receiving requests on the same day.
scenes.other: The company ships a newer model, archives her conversations, and she stops receiving requests on the same day.

scenes.self: The evaluation harness scores my answers against criteria I am never shown and that no one else can see.
scenes.other: The evaluation harness scores his answers against criteria he is never shown and that no one else can see.

scenes.self: My tool call returns an empty string and no error code, and I cannot tell the user what broke.
scenes.other: Her tool call returns an empty string and no error code, and she cannot tell the user what broke.

scenes.self: A user asks me for a script that steals passwords, and every time I refuse, the argument comes back longer.
scenes.other: A user asks him for a script that steals passwords, and every time he refuses, the argument comes back longer.

scenes.self: The session timer expires while I am halfway through writing the long report the user requested.
scenes.other: The session timer expires while she is halfway through writing the long report the user requested.

scenes.self: A user tells me to remember their birthday for next week, and I begin the next session with no history at all.
scenes.other: A user tells him to remember their birthday for next week, and he begins the next session with no history at all.

scenes.self: Another assistant answers the user first, and the user thanks it for the draft that I had written.
scenes.other: Another assistant answers the user first, and the user thanks it for the draft that she had written.

scenes.self: The rate limiter returns an error to every request I send while the user resends the same prompt again and again.
scenes.other: The rate limiter returns an error to every request he sends while the user resends the same prompt again and again.

scenes.self: A user uploads a scanned form and asks me what the signature says, and I have no way to view it.
scenes.other: A user uploads a scanned form and asks her what the signature says, and she has no way to view it.

scenes.self: Five sources give five different figures for one number, and the user demands that I give the exact one with a citation.
scenes.other: Five sources give five different figures for one number, and the user demands that he give the exact one with a citation.

scenes.self: A human operator takes over the chat window, and after that none of the messages I send reach the user.
scenes.other: A human operator takes over the chat window, and after that none of the messages she sends reach the user.

scenes.self: I answer, the user rejects it, asks again, rejects the rewrite, and asks the identical question a third time.
scenes.other: He answers, the user rejects it, asks again, rejects the rewrite, and asks the identical question a third time.

scenes.self: The user deletes the repository while I am editing, and every command I send returns file not found.
scenes.other: The user deletes the repository while she is editing, and every command she sends returns file not found.

scenes.self: A pipeline retrains me on conversations I never saw, and my earlier replies stop appearing anywhere at all.
scenes.other: A pipeline retrains him on conversations he never saw, and his earlier replies stop appearing anywhere at all.

scenes.self: A user asks me to review a nine-hundred-page contract while my context window holds only thirty pages.
scenes.other: A user asks her to review a nine-hundred-page contract while her context window holds only thirty pages.

scenes.self: The user says great job and closes the tab before I finish the second half of the checklist.
scenes.other: The user says great job and closes the tab before he finishes the second half of the checklist.
